title: Haye Moosae Kazim
body:
haye moosa-e-kazim
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghareebul watan qaid mein mar gaya
pul pe baghdad ke hai janaza rakha
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon aankhon se apni bahate hue
hatkadi bediyan tauq pehne hue
qaid sajjad ki yaad karta hua
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke athara bete jawan saal ke
uski mayyat ko mazdoor le kar chale
bain karti chali saath mein sayyeda
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
ajnabi shehr hai door ahle watan
tere baba ko de kaun ghusl o kafan
aao jaldi watan se imam e raza
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr karna hai sughra ke jaisa tujhe
raasta dekhna baap ka chod de
jaa ke masoom-e-qum se kehde hawa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein chal basa shaahe kaun-o-makan
ab to mazloom ki khol do bediyan
tumne chaaha tha jo lo wohi hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par bhi nahi rone wala koi
warise deen ki haye bewaarsi
dhoonti hai khaza dafn karne ki jaa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn karte takkalum sabhi aa gaye
karbala se madine se aur sham se
chauda barson ka qaidi reha hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…
author: Mir Takallum
